sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's pace is well-balanced, providing a sense of urgency without overwhelming the player. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various challenges, obstacles, and surprises that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

The game's controls are user-friendly, allowing players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate through the questions with ease. This flexibility makes the game accessible to a wide range of players, regardless of their device or skill level. With each level, you'll face a new set of questions, and you'll have three chances to get it wrong before the level ends.

One of the most appealing aspects of "Quiz Against Time" is its randomization feature. Each time you play a level, the questions will be randomly selected from a vast database, ensuring that you'll never encounter the same set of questions twice. This feature adds a layer of unpredictability to the game, keeping you on your toes and encouraging you to think critically and strategically.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of "Quiz Against Time" are engaging, challenging, and well-designed, providing a thrilling experience for trivia enthusiasts and casual gamers alike.
